p: make known his deeds among the: For as much as the Israelites were exempted from the common condemnation of the world, and were elected to be God's people, the prophet wills them to show themselves mindful by thanksgiving.
strength: By the strength and face he means the ark where God declared his power and his presence.
marvellous works that he hath done: Which he has wrought in the deliverance of his people.
judgments of his mouth: Because his power was declared living by this, as if he would have declared it by mouth.
made with Abraham: The promise God made to Abraham to be his God, and the God of his seed after him, he renewed and repeated again to his seed after him.
Unto thee will I give the: He shows that they would not enjoy the land of Canaan by any other means, but by reason of his covenant made with their fathers.
kings for their sakes: That is, the king of Egypt and the king of Gerar, Ge 12:17,20:3
anointed: Those whom I have sanctified to be my people.
prophets no harm: Meaning, the old fathers, to whom God showed himself plainly, and who set forth his word.
staff of bread: Either by sending scarcity or the strength and nourishment of it.
the time that his word came: So long he suffered adversity as God had appointed, and till he had sufficiently tried his patience.
princes at his pleasure: That the very princes of the countries would be at Joseph's commandment, and learn wisdom from him.
He turned their heart to hate: So it is in God, either to move the hearts of the wicked to love or to hate God's children.
rebelled not against his word: Meaning, Moses and Aaron.
spake: So that this vermin did not come by chance, but as God had appointed, and his prophet Moses spoke.
hail for rain: It was strange to see rain in Egypt, much more it was fearful to see hail.
He spake: He shows that all creatures are armed against man when God is his enemy as at his commandment the grasshoppers destroyed the land.
not one feeble person among their: When their enemies felt God's plagues his children by his providence were exempted.
glad when they departed: For God's plagues caused them to prefer to depart with the Israelites rather than with their lives.
asked: Not for necessity but for satisfying of their lust.
promise: Which he confirms to the posterity in whom after a sort the dead live and enjoy the promises.
joy: When the Egyptians lamented and were destroyed.
observe his statutes: This is the reason why God preserves his Church, because they should worship and call on him in this world.
